title: R' Shimon ben Zira
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Kiddushin 76b, teaching in the Kiddushin collection of the school of Levi. He is also mentioned in Tanchuma, Bereshit 3. It appears to Hyman that the name should read R' Shimon ben Nezira.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: עו:/בראשית-ג give 76b/Bereshit 3 by convention and literal numeral, without a newly verified modern edition. Supplied בקידושי/תנחומא differ from earlier machine בקירושי/הנחומא בראשיתהג.
תני בקידושי דבי לוי is rendered as teaching in the school’s Kiddushin collection, an interpretive gloss without inventing the teaching’s content or asserting a specific recension.
ונראה preserves Hyman’s tentative Zira-to-Nezira correction. ר״ש is locally Shimon, with title R'; heading title likewise remains R'. No identity or source correction is adopted.
